title: DesignTaste: Benchmarking AI-Generator Visual Design Against Award-Wining Works
abstract: arXiv:2611.16442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image benchmarks commonly assess text-image alignment or overall preference. Whether models can produce good designs when a brief leaves the appearance open remains less well understood. We introduce DesignTaste, a visual design benchmark that compares generated images with award-winning works. From these works and their publicly available context, we derive 403 design briefs: 100 poster tasks from 100 Beste Plakate 2025 and 303 tasks spanning 20 categories from ADC 2026. Six leading commercial text-to-image models each generate an image from the same brief. A single model judge scores each output and the corresponding award-winning work independently on five evaluation dimensions. On each dataset, only ArtArk achieves a higher mean overall score than the award-winning works. All six models score lower in Creative Originality on both datasets. translated_title: DesignTaste：将AI生成的视觉设计与获奖作品进行基准测试对比
translated_abstract: 文生图基准通常评估文本-图像的对齐程度或整体偏好，然而当设计简报对外观不做具体限定时，模型能否产出优秀的设计，目前仍知之甚少。我们提出了DesignTaste，一个将生成图像与获奖作品进行对比的视觉设计基准。基于这些获奖作品及其公开可得的背景信息，我们推导出403个设计简报：其中100个海报任务来自“2025年百佳海报”，另外303个任务涵盖ADC 2026的20个类别。六款领先的商用文生图模型各自根据相同的设计简报生成一幅图像。由单一模型评判者基于五个评估维度，对每个生成结果与对应的获奖作品进行独立打分。在两个数据集上，仅有ArtArk的平均总分超过了获奖作品。所有六个模型在两个数据集上的“创意原创性”维度得分均较低。这些结果表明，生成完整且具有视觉吸引力的图像并不意味着……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DesignTaste基准，将六款领先商用文生图模型的生成结果与403个设计简报对应的获奖作品进行对比评分，发现仅有ArtArk在总体得分上超过获奖作品，且所有模型在创意原创性上均表现不足。
